categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC argument handling in src/rpc/net.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a signed integer overflow and silent ban drop when users pass extreme relative ban durations to setban. BanMan calculates ban expiration as GetTime() + bantime using signed 64-bit integers, where extreme values wrapped negative and silently dropped the ban while reporting success; rejecting inputs over UINT32_MAX resolves the undefined behavior and caller misdirection.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: The one-line change to -bantime parsing in src/init.cpp serves net ban behavior rather than general argument handling infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Not a utils member because settings changes whose point is a specific subsystem's behavior belong to that subsystem rather than shared utility infrastructure.
